modules.apiContract: validate_id(raw,profile); rescale(i64,sourceScale,targetScale,rounding); canonical_digest(typeId,version,fields). Result is a typed value or InvalidId/UnitMismatch/Overflow/UnsupportedProfile, never a grant.
modules.stateAndEncoding: No store. Wire u64 counters use exact decimal strings where JSON clients cannot represent them; bytes/digests remain exact. Numeric values carry unit, shape, scale and rounding profile. Preserve the existing StableId grammar.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Pure deterministic value construction is the linearization point. No clocks, I/O, global registry or identity normalization. Version/profile mismatch rejects before conversion.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Checked i128 product, Euclidean magnitude quotient/remainder, restore sign; nearest ties go to even magnitude. Digest variable fields with explicit domain and length. Never quantize authority/fence/deletion fields.
modules.acceptanceOracle: +2.5->2,+3.5->4,-2.5->-2,-3.5->-4; overflow rejects; equal numeric ppm/Q24 values retain different source digests. Cross-language golden bytes must match.

modules.apiContract: decode_envelope(bytes,negotiatedVersion,limits); encode_envelope(value,version); negotiate(local,remote,criticalFeatures). Preserve existing transport framing and reject unknown critical fields.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Only connection-local frameLength,receivedBytes,version,deadline. No domain state, SQL handle or deserializable VerifiedUse token. The new handoff profile is not admitted by a JSON file alone.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Domain invocation starts only after complete validation. Disconnect destroys partial decode state and renegotiates; no automatic retry of unknown external effects.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Admission before allocation: <=1 MiB envelope, depth<=32, fields<=1024 and buffer<=2 frames, subject to stricter existing schema. Deterministically select the highest explicitly common compatible version.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Truncate a valid message at every byte offset: no owner callback until complete. Critical unknown version rejects; a serialized witness cannot construct a consumable token.

modules.apiContract: verify_use(principal,operation,destination,finalDigest,epoch,now); revoke(lease,expectedRevision). Only the owner issues an opaque one-entry token. Adapter entry and revocation use one serialized admission gate.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Lease and revocation records bind scope, operation, destination, digest, monotone epoch, expiry, predecessor and key reference. Raw keys never enter general evidence. The durable revocation frontier survives restore.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Revoke commits the frontier before returning. Gate entry rechecks it and records admission order without holding a lock during network I/O. Previously admitted effects remain in-flight; revocation is not retroactive cancellation or terminal success.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Authenticate, compare every bound field, check current epoch/expiry, consume once, enter adapter. A reflex payload change invalidates the token and requires a new final binding or veto. Fail closed when revocation state is unavailable.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Race entry/revoke under a controlled schedule: post-revoke entries deny; earlier entered operations remain tracked and cancellation is best-effort. Changed destination/digest denies; restoring an older DB cannot revive the lease.

modules.apiContract: prepare_intent(id,scope,destination,payload,expectedPredecessor); claim(id,fence); observe_terminal(id,authenticatedEvidence). Duplicate same semantics returns prior receipt; changed semantics conflicts.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Owner intent/outbox record has operationId,semanticDigest,state,predecessor,epoch,claimFence,attempt,deadline,nextEligibleTime,observerRef. Destination owns dedupe/apply and its acknowledgement.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Local state+outbox commit together. Claim CAS follows current fence. Sent with lost acknowledgement stays Indeterminate. A current-fence reconciler alone records Applied/NotApplied/Quarantined; compensation has a new operation ID.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Pending<=100000/shard, claim batch<=256, retries bounded per effect profile. Retry only proven pre-dispatch failures or registered destination idempotency. Never infer not-applied from timeout.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Kill before/after commit/send/ack: no pre-commit dispatch, one dedupe identity, no blind resend after unknown send. Reused ID with changed payload and stale-fence settlement reject.

modules.apiContract: append_receipt(envelope,authenticatedIssuer); verify_chain(candidate,roles,now); query_claim(candidate,class). Return supported/missing/expired/conflicting, not one global complete boolean.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Append-only candidate/tree/class/issuer/key/payload/previous/observedAt/expiry/revocation references. Asset logs remain bounded content-addressed references. Correction supersedes, never erases original receipts.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Authenticate principal and role certificate before append; sync evidence before index publication. Two display names sharing one principal/key chain do not establish independence. Current revocations overlay restored indexes.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Receipt<=256 KiB, assets<=64, traversal<=256 edges, query<=512 references. Detect cycles, role collision and budget exhaustion; incomplete verification is not validity.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Hardware claim backed only by fixture evidence rejects. Equal issuer principal under different names rejects. Wrong tree, broken predecessor, expired signature and revoked key return unsupported.

modules.apiContract: authorize(principal,action,policyRevision); reserve(quotaKey,amount,operation,expectedRevision); settle(reservation,observedCost,terminalEvidence). Policy decision and quota are not an effect.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Exact-unit quota limit,available,reserved,consumed; reservation ID,scope,policy,amount,expiry,state,settlement digest. Use integer quota units and reject negative/overflowing costs.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Atomic last-unit reservation under the single owner. Identical settlement idempotent; changed cost conflicts. Expiry with uncertain consumption holds/quarantines the reserve instead of refunding twice.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Invariant available+reserved+consumed=endowment under registered replenishment events; batch<=128, metadata<=16 KiB, active principal cap explicit. Reconcile after restart before issuing new reservations.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Endowment=1 and two concurrent reservations: one succeeds. Reserve 7 of 10, settle actual 5: available=5,reserved=0,consumed=5; retry preserves values. Unknown cost does not release 7.

modules.apiContract: request_secret_lease(reference,grant,operation); renew(lease,grant); revoke(lease,grant). Secret delivery uses the dedicated consumer channel, not a receipt payload.
modules.stateAndEncoding: External authority owns values/leases. Local metadata is provider identity,lease reference,consumer scope,expiry,rotation generation and revocation state. Sealed caches are TTL-bound and excluded from datasets/exports.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Final provider request consumes payload-bound authority. Lost acknowledgement is reconciled with provider lease identity. Rotation invalidates caches; old backups cannot reset revocation.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Metadata<=16 KiB; one typed external operation per request; bounded renewals/TTL. Freeze external source/API pin and instance identity; no ambient provider fallback.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Canary secret never occurs in logs/errors/receipts/datasets. Rotation plus restart rejects old generation. Provider timeout remains unknown instead of minting another unrestricted lease.

modules.apiContract: start_instance(selectedSnapshot,hostProfile); observe_health(instance,generation,monotonicTime,status); drain(instance); load_next(independentlySelectedArtifactSet). Does not train or self-select.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Instance state binds executable digest,argv/config digests,PID/start identity,body generation,phase,watchdog deadline,acquired resources and restart count. Existing canonical owners retain lifecycle/selection facts.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: New generation and fence before admission; readiness after storage/revocation checks, not process liveness alone. Stop admission, drain, reconcile, fence, then restart. Release only resources actually acquired.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Instances<=256, health batch<=256, restart<=3 per configured recovery window. Bounded backoff never runs on the emergency path. Watchdog/profile timings are measured target requirements.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Crash at each startup acquisition leaves no leaked handle. Stale health cannot ready a new process. New-process artifact load changes behavior; revoked predecessor blocks rollback.

modules.apiContract: admit_host(explicitEnrollment,capacity,epoch); allocate(requests,capacitySnapshot,policy); renew_or_revoke(allocation,fence,observation). Discovery is not enrollment.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Allocation binds host/failure domain,principal,integer resource vector,essential floor,reserve,expiry,generation and predecessor. Capacity observations carry freshness/uncertainty.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Commit allocation generation atomically. A partitioned or stale host receives no new grant; expired local leases fail closed. Do not reallocate uncertain hard resources until reconciliation.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Reserve safety/evidence/rollback floors; deterministic weighted max-min allocation with stable-ID ties. Hosts<=256, requests<=4096, axes<=32. No overcommit for hard limits or synchronous global optimizer in local loops.
modules.acceptanceOracle: For each axis sum(grants)<=capacity and essential floors hold. Permuting request order preserves plan digest. Partition/expiry never grants the same hard allocation twice.

modules.apiContract: compose_runtime(supervisorSnapshot,ownerPorts,config); start_run(request,objective,body,artifacts); cancel_run(id); attach_context(run,receipt). Use existing Codex spine and injected owner ports.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Ephemeral run handles and immutable snapshot references only. Store paths/file handles are constructed by the registered owner composition, not an agentd-owned all-purpose database.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Freeze objective/body/artifact tuple before start. Cancel-before-dispatch prevents entry; cancel-after-entry preserves unknown/terminal truth. Restart reconstructs owner state rather than guessing from caches.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Active runs<=256; ingress<=1024; stage deadlines derive from run budget. Missing critical owner blocks readiness; optional advice has a bounded read-only/abstain fallback.
modules.acceptanceOracle: C1 must name a real host entrypoint and consumer callsites; a fixture port is labelled fixture. Mixed generations reject. Filesystem audit finds no undeclared domain store.

modules.apiContract: open_thread(session,version); submit_turn(thread,context,objective); dispatch_tool(turn,finalCall,verifiedUse); observe_delivery(turn,payloadDigest). Preserve upstream app-server protocol.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Thread/turn principal,sequence,selected model/runtime,context/tool-schema digests and lifecycle. External effect truth remains with destination/operations owner, not generated model prose.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Revalidate evidence at physical request assembly, bind actual tokenizer/template, record delivery only after matching payload submission. Tool entry consumes current final grant. Provider timeout is not a proven safe retry.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Token/context limits come from exact model profile; candidate tool set<=128 and reserved dispatch concurrency. Separate queue,first-token,last-token,assembly and terminal-tool timings.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Compiled but unsent prompt receives no exposure credit. Post-authorization payload drift denies. Missing model/session profile cannot choose ambient defaults. Unknown tool outcome remains pending.

modules.apiContract: reserve_request(request,modelManifest,quota); schedule(reservation,eligibleWorkers); cancel(id,expectedRevision); settle(observation,epoch). Request/lease/reservation must bind identical model/payload.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Request principal,model,payload,deadline,state; reservation quota/resource/worker generation; receipt usage/output digest/finality. One owner persists assignment with dispatch outbox.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Owner CAS resolves cancel/finish: terminal observation is recorded once; late actual usage is still charged. Worker cannot refund the owner reservation. Unknown consumption stays held/quarantined.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Queue<=4096/shard, batch<=256, metadata<=64 KiB. Schedule only eligible enrolled workers. Retry budget covers proven pre-dispatch infrastructure failures, not unchanged semantic rejection.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Cancel and finish in either ordering yield one settlement and no double refund. Wrong model/digest denies before dispatch. Worker disappearance does not imply zero usage.

modules.apiContract: load_model(verifiedManifest,resourceGrant); run(request,lease,reservation,cancellation); unload(handle,deadline). Pure receipt validation is not model execution.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Ephemeral model/process generation,read-only model descriptor,KV/cache handles,request handles,usage counters. Artifact/cache owner retains persistent model bytes.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Check exact weights/tokenizer/preprocessor/quantization/license/runtime/device tuple before loading. Release acquired resources on failure. Drain outstanding requests before compatible unload/reload.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Concurrent models,tokens,accelerator memory and cancellations use explicit grants and selected model bounds. Separate real encoder latency from deterministic feature-fixture latency.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Changing tokenizer with equal model ID rejects. Kill at each load step leaves no leaked memory/FD. Real-use receipt identifies a binary,weights,device and actual consumer; synthetic output cannot substitute.

modules.apiContract: register_schedule(spec,principal,revision); materialize_due(schedule,interval,clockProfile); claim_occurrence(id,fence); execute_step(claim,typedIntent). Occurrence key=schedule+revision+canonical instant.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Schedule timezone/rule/start/end/missed-run policy; occurrence UTC instant,claim fence,step graph,intents,terminal observation,recovery phase. Orchestration owns no foreign domain facts.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Idempotently persist occurrence then fence claim. An unknown step effect blocks dependent mutations. Compensation is a new authorized step with its own observed outcome.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Scan<=1024 occurrences, graph<=128 steps, ready<=32. DST gap/overlap choose registered skip/first/second policy; missed runs use bounded skip/coalesce/catch-up. No unlimited recovery backlog.
modules.acceptanceOracle: DST repeated civil time yields distinct explicit UTC occurrence policy. Two schedulers cannot execute one current claim twice. Crash after send cannot blindly rerun a step.

modules.apiContract: admit_event(room,event,syncGeneration,principal); prepare_send(room,digest,operation,grant); observe_send(transaction,serverEvidence). Room text remains untrusted evidence.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Ingress keys homeserver+room+event; source digest,sync position,sender evidence,redaction/scope. Dispatch keys operation+transaction and binds payload,session generation,epoch,server event.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Dedupe and sync-frontier advancement commit together or through durable staged publication. Lost send acknowledgement retains transaction ID. Server persistence and human reading are distinct claims.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Ingress batch<=512; per-room queue<=2048; payload/reconnect limits from registered profile. Reconnect replays current redaction/revocation before exposing old cached content.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Repeated sync event adds no duplicate learning event. Room/session/payload drift denies. Ack loss remains indeterminate. Redacted content cannot return after reconnect/restore.

modules.apiContract: open_profile(profileId,grant,browserManifest); observe_page(session,pageGeneration,budget); navigate_or_act(session,typedAction,finalPayload,grant). Observation/navigation/input/download/credential use are separate classes.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Isolated profile with cookie/secret references,allowed origins,process/session/page generation and outstanding operations. DOM/GUI evidence is bounded,redacted,origin-bound and non-authoritative.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Revalidate target element/page before entry. Actual destination and payload bind the token. Crash after form submission preserves unknown remote business effect; page load is not transaction success.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Tabs<=16/granted profile; observation nodes/bytes,downloads,timeouts,network/FS scope are profile-bounded. Exact Servo source/patch pins are deployment evidence.
modules.acceptanceOracle: An element from page generation 1 cannot click generation 2. Page instructions cannot expand scope. Cross-principal profile reuse rejects. Unknown submission is reconciled, never automatically resubmitted.

modules.apiContract: read_view(cursor); submit_request(intent,displayedRevision,session); request_stop(scope,session). Generated clients call backend owners; UI cannot issue authority or accept its own candidate.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Presentation-only connection generation,view revision,pending IDs,focus and scoped preferences. Pending/indeterminate/terminal are distinct visible states. Final confirmation binds displayed target/digest/revision.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Reconcile acknowledgements by request identity; disconnect does not prove cancellation. Version or revision drift disables mutations. Stop/takeover does not depend on model cooperation.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: View<=1 MiB, retained events<=1000, bounded render batches. Keyboard/screen-reader access includes uncertainty and stop. UI response timing is not hardware emergency-stop timing.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Confirming old revision cannot act on a changed target. Reconnect sends no duplicate operation. Accessibility flow preserves focus and exposes pending/unknown result rather than a false success badge.

modules.apiContract: connect_runtime(endpointManifest,session); render_runtime_view(generation); request_platform_capability(action,intent); apply_shell_update(selectedPackage,evidence). OS permission and Hepta grant are both required where applicable.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Window/session/preferences only; secure OS storage holds opaque references through secret boundary. Update binds signed artifact,OS/architecture,backend compatibility and predecessor.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Explicit process restart after independent update selection. Reconnect reconciles pending operations. Crash/exit never erases unknown effects or revives revoked sessions.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Bounded event/cache/reconnect/update retries; freeze startup/RSS/interaction targets for named platform. No blanket device/FS permission acquired for convenience.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Native/web views agree on unknown/terminal states. OS denial blocks operation. Unsigned/incompatible update rejects; compatible signed rollback is tested without auth downgrade.

modules.apiContract: validate_memory_event(event,profile); validate_span(asset,modality,range); compile_snapshot_key(frontiers,generations,scope). Preserve native types and register new versions before wire use.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Tagged text byte,image region,audio sample,video frame,AST,GUI,trajectory and sensor spans bind source asset and encoder/preprocessor digests. Events keep hypothesis/correction/tombstone kinds distinct.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Pure validation before asset access; no store,SQL,clock or writer. Reject wrong modality units,invalid range/overflow and unsupported schema before returning a typed object.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Spans<=32,event references<=64,metadata<=256 KiB. Canonical semantic order and explicit range units; embeddings never replace source identity.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Text byte offsets supplied as audio samples reject. Out-of-bounds frames/regions reject. Cross-language encoding preserves source/profile identity and does not merge contradictory observations.

modules.apiContract: Reuse CognitiveStore::append/get/snapshot_records as in-memory semantic oracle. Planned durable owner adapter appends event/correction/tombstone under expected frontier and writer fence.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Observed baseline CognitiveStore uses BTreeMap and caps live records at 16384; no persistent store is proved. Proposed SQLite profile defines frontier,event,current_record,revocation,mutation,publication_intent; it does not replace existing bytes silently.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; verify current fence/frontier; preflight counters; append immutable revision; advance current reference; append mutation receipt then local publication intent; commit with WAL+FULL; acknowledge after committed frontier witness. Apply current deletion overlay before reads.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Preserve 16384 live-ID cap until separately qualified; metadata<=256 KiB,batch<=256. Same identity/digest returns prior receipt; changed semantics require predecessor+revision CAS. Retention does not discard acknowledged anchors.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Two writers with same predecessor yield one success and one conflict. Reopen after commit retains event. Restoring a pre-forget snapshot overlays tombstone before reads. A tombstone alone is not model unlearning.

modules.apiContract: acquire_snapshot(scope,frontiers,generations); read_ids(snapshot,ids,fields); revalidate(packet,currentRevocation). Export a read port, never a writer/SQL connection.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Ephemeral pins and scoped projection cache. Key includes purpose,source revision,tombstone frontier,KG/engram generation,encoder/preprocessor and requested fields.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Acquire coherent declared source cut; redact and apply current revocations; release pins on cancel/expiry. Revalidate at actual model-request assembly; individually valid reads from mixed cuts are not a coherent snapshot.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: IDs<=512,result<=1 MiB subject to context limit; lifetime<=request deadline; host-bounded pins/cache. Slow readers expire instead of retaining unbounded history.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Changing one source revision invalidates packet. Equal query from another principal cannot hit cache. Cancel releases pins. Partial projection generation returns unavailable rather than complete empty result.

modules.apiContract: compile_cue(objective,approvedContext,snapshot); retrieve(cue,channelBudgets); recall(candidateUnion,engram,policy). Log enumerated/truncated generator-relative candidates through ledger owner.
modules.stateAndEncoding: No fact writer. Recall/cache binds full snapshot,cue,retrieval/encoder profile,quotas,truncation and revocation. Source IDs/revisions and support remain resolvable.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Parallel channel results are canonicalized before assignment; stable exact-revision dedupe,source quotas and bounded truncation precede logged propensity. Current source revalidation precedes attachment.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: <=512 events,4096 nodes,32768 edges,4 settling steps,16 results,64 active units/population. Contradictory high-risk support abstains; similarity is not truth.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Permute channel completion order: identical candidate digest. Revoke top-ranked source before delivery: it cannot attach. Equal-budget lexical/no-recurrence/no-inhibition baselines retain independent outcome labels.

modules.apiContract: query_peer(enrollment,scopedQuery,snapshotPolicy,lease); revalidate_remote(result,epoch); cancel_query(id). No peer enrollment,remote mutation or inherited credentials.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Remote evidence remains owned remotely; local cache stores peer/principal/query/frontier/expiry/deletion cutoff and bounded references. Consent comes from authority/fleet owners.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Validate enrolled peer and current read grant before send; verify returned producer/scope/frontier. Timeout returns partial coverage/unavailable, not valid empty evidence. Restore discards revoked cache.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Peers<=16/request,total IDs<=512,explicit per-peer deadline and bounded read retry. Never widen query scope to compensate for missing coverage.
modules.acceptanceOracle: One unavailable peer produces a partial result with missing coverage. Wrong principal denies. A discovered peer receives no query/credential until enrolled. Remote deletion invalidates cached and restored results.

modules.apiContract: consume_source_batch(frontier,facts,corrections,tombstones); build_generation(candidate,profile); publish_generation(expectedPredecessor,generation); query_relations(snapshot,seeds,bounds).
modules.stateAndEncoding: Rebuildable node/edge projections keyed generation+identity; edge has relation,support revisions,confidence,validity and tombstone frontier. Supports/contradicts are separate edge kinds.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Build off-route,validate complete support manifest,then atomically publish pointer for one source cut. Partial generation never becomes readable. Source owner remains truth authority.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Query<=4096 nodes/32768 edges/output512 refs,batch<=10000 source records. Incremental and full rebuild must be semantically equal for identical cuts. Last revoked support removes/invalidates edge.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Incremental/full canonical graph digests match. Half-built graph cannot publish. Deleting sole support makes edge ineligible. Contradictions remain alternatives rather than an averaged unsupported fact.

modules.apiContract: plan_compaction(snapshot,retention,budget); build_checkpoint(candidate); plan_replay(eligibleEvents,quotas,profile); propose_skill(episodes,preconditions,effects,termination,recovery).
modules.stateAndEncoding: Checkpoint binds source range,supports,algorithm,compressed digest,omissions,tombstones,compatibility and predecessor. Summaries/skills/replay are projections or candidates,never replacement truth.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Construct off-route and publish only after retention/contradiction validation. Failed build leaves old complete checkpoint. Source forget revokes derived candidates before restore/recall.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Replay candidates<=4096,selected<=256. Deterministic quotas and stable ranking by retention risk,error,coverage,utility. Record foreground interference and read-utility loss as well as compression ratio.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Required source/provenance remains resolvable. Deleted episode cannot enter replay/skill. Old-task/contradiction fixtures fail lossy overcompression. Crash before pointer publication leaves predecessor intact.

modules.apiContract: admit_factor(factor,reviewedScope); register_realization(factorRevision,modelProfile,digest); revoke_factor(id,cutoff); read_compatible(snapshot,modelTuple,contextProfile).
modules.stateAndEncoding: Factor semantic identity differs from realization text. Realization binds model/version/tokenizer/template/tool schema,locale,role,payload,token cost,expiry. Lifecycle transitions append by owner revision.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Atomic immutable revision+lifecycle publication. Optimizer is read-only. Revalidate revocation between selection and physical delivery. Registry insertion never selects a current-run factor.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Candidates<=128,realization<=64 KiB,refs<=64; actual tokenizer cost,not character count. External evidence needs independent governed admission before an instruction role.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Same factor/incompatible tokenizer cannot silently reuse text. Page content cannot self-admit. Revoke after optimization prevents delivery. Duplicate revision with altered payload conflicts.

modules.apiContract: compile_context(objective,evidence,portfolio,modelProfile,budget); revalidate_attachment(receipt,currentSnapshot). Compilation is not physical delivery or permission to call a provider.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Ephemeral structured payload and exact source/factor/model/tokenizer/template/tool-schema digests; omitted groups and token cost. Cache includes every revision and revocation cutoff.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Revalidate coherent evidence,pack,hash,then Codex assembly revalidates and observes actual identical payload. Drift returns stale and cannot receive delivered-factor credit.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Reserve mandatory instruction/schema/provenance/contradiction floors. Stable greedy value-per-cost packing preserves required groups; <=128 factors,512 evidence candidates. If floors do not fit, refuse rather than truncate authority.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Tiny budget returns insufficient_context. Untrusted evidence cannot occupy a trusted role. Stale source invalidates cache. Actual sent payload mismatch prevents causal attribution.

modules.apiContract: compile(sourceEnvelope,baselineProfile); check_feasibility(typedConstraints,budget). Model extraction is an untrusted IR candidate. Results distinguish feasible,infeasible,unsupported_language,budget_exhausted.
modules.stateAndEncoding: No durable owner. Caller records immutable ObjectiveFunction/RunStartSnapshot with scope,success/terminal predicates,hard constraints,actions,evidence sources,resources,risk,revision and digest.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Normalize and solve pure IR before adaptive logic. A semantic objective/acceptance change starts a new authorized run. Unsupported/exhausted never drops a constraint or relabels the problem infeasible.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Interval/set intersection and positive Horn implication closure only. <=256 constraints,128 predicates/actions,256 KiB. Sorting O(n log n); inclusion-minimal conflict filtering <=n+1 oracle calls and O(n*C(n)), not minimum cardinality.
modules.acceptanceOracle: [0,1] intersect [2,3] infeasible; irrelevant atom removed from core. Permutations yield equal IR. Nonlinear/unsupported atoms or exhausted oracle preserve original objective and grant no new action.

modules.apiContract: Reuse evaluate_candidates,solve_preference_target,validate_staged_updates,evaluate_recursive_utility and mul_q32_ties_even. Planned conditional solver uses centered Z*Sigma=B with an admitted coefficient profile.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Append preference/utility projections by scope+subject+objective+predecessor+event+coefficient. Temporal state may advance; selected parameter bytes and objective do not change within run.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Owner CAS appends successor and publishes eligible pointer atomically. Parent revisions freeze; parent/child artifacts never select together. Revoked coefficient or unsupported covariance routes to deterministic predecessor.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Hard feasibility->Pareto->registered scalarization. P<=64,U<=8,resource/risk<=32,candidates<=128,depth4,iterations64,eta[1/16,1/4]. Full-rank covariance solve requires declared conditioning/eigenfloor and condition<=1e6.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Sigma=2dt,U=3m recovers Z=3,not6; correlated [[2,1],[1,2]],B=[5,1] recovers[3,-1]. Hard privacy breach filters before score. Fixed external outcome detects preference-driven reward redefinition.

modules.apiContract: collect_snapshot(ownerSummaries,frontiers,expiry); plan(snapshot,objective,candidates,budgets); request_execution_grants(plan). A plan is not a grant or effect.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Global snapshot is a projection of readiness,resource,risk,organ,NDU with age/missing masks. Decision records complete candidates,rejections,solver,bounds,chosen frontier,uncertainty and fallback.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Freeze body/objective/artifact generation and coherent owner cut; validate before selecting a plan. Stale contributions are unknown/unavailable,not zero cost. Owners retain authoritative facts.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Reserve essential floors,hard filter,Pareto,registered scalarization. Plans<=128,initial organ roles<=24,resource axes<=32. Optimality only over certified bounded candidate set. Local controllers have no central synchronous RPC.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Overload preserves safety/evidence/rollback floor. Stale summary prevents unsupported plan. Changed generation invalidates prepared result. Central outage cannot disable qualified local reflex.

modules.apiContract: Reuse DurableLedger,LedgerAnchor,LedgerRecovery and inspect_ledger. Host-authenticated adapter admits decision,outcome,correction/revoke and dataset freeze; pure LearningLedger is not durable proof.
modules.stateAndEncoding: Keep native durable_codec format and anchor; do not replace with a Python/SQLite product ledger. Rows bind full legal set,propensity,actual delivery,independent outcome/watermark,credit conservation and source->dataset->artifact ancestry.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Prepare under expected anchor; encode/sync; publish owner state; persist independent acknowledgement witness; acknowledge. On failed anchored recovery never retry unanchored. Unknown outcome remains pending/censored.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Candidates<=128,episode events<=4096,row<=256 KiB subject to stricter native segment/record limits. Segment rotation is a migration preserving anchors,not deletion of old confirmed history.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Ack loss reconciles original operation/anchor. Truncating acknowledged history fails recovery. Observer display-name substitution fails host authentication. Delayed correction changes eligibility without rewriting prior truth.

modules.apiContract: build_sensor_core(design,applicability); fit_transition(dataset,dynamicsProfile); fit_value_operator(dataset,sensorCore,objective,profile); predict_candidate(model,state,action). Dynamics and value are separate artifacts/losses.
modules.stateAndEncoding: No source writer. Immutable data and sensor designs; artifact manifest includes smooth/jump/hard partition,units,rank,architecture,code/device,data lineage,error budget and applicability.
modules.linearizationAndRecovery: Training emits create-only candidates through artifact owner. Sensor core cannot be replaced by an experience replay cache. Synthetic trajectories remain synthetic and cannot satisfy independent effect observation.
modules.algorithmAndBounds: Start scalar/tabular monotone reference. Smooth dims<=32,sensors<=4096,rank<=64,reconstruction gain<=1.02,total normalized error<=0.05 where applicable. Residual mode only on qualified near-greedy subset; no noise on hard axes.
modules.acceptanceOracle: Analytic Bellman/sensor goldens match. Bad mesh/degenerate diffusion disables learned path. High train fit with bad future calibration rejects. Action-conditioned world-model tests use held-out one/multistep error separately from utility.

modules.apiContract: freeze_plan(estimand,baseline,candidate,splits,thresholds); audit_support(dataset,plan); evaluate_single_decision; evaluate_trajectory; evaluate_retention_and_unlearning. Estimand class is mandatory.

modules.acceptanceOracle: Same ID/different bytes conflicts. Kill after byte sync leaves an orphan,not a selected artifact. New loader refuses corrupt payload. Revoked/incompatible predecessor cannot be restored from stale registry backup.
